captions.detailed: An independent rear suspension (IRS) half-shaft assembly consisting of an inboard constant-velocity (CV) joint coupling, a central drive shaft, and an outboard CV joint integrated with a wheel hub. The inboard coupling features a cylindrical black housing with mounting studs, while the central shaft is a slender black rod flanked by flexible protective boots. At the outboard end, the wheel hub is a circular black flange with five protruding silver lug bolts, allowing continuous rotation of the wheel relative to the shaft.
captions.instruction: Design an independent rear suspension (IRS) rear half-shaft assembly using CadQuery. The model should feature an inboard CV coupling, a central rotating drive shaft with protective boots, and an outboard wheel hub complete with mounting lug bolts.
captions.factory: Construct the inboard coupling housing using a combination of cylinders and a boolean subtraction to create the hollow interior. Model the central drive shaft using a long cylinder, and create the protective CV boots by stacking concentric cylinders of varying diameters. Build the outboard wheel hub flange from a thin, wide cylinder, and programmatically distribute five smaller cylinders around its perimeter to represent the threaded lug bolts.
